{{Top|leg}}
The '''Sense of the Veshet''' was a [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsister]] [[Dathomir Magic|technique]] that allowed the user to distinguish scents carried by the wind one hundred [[Meter/Legends|meters]] away, and to see on a moonless pitch black night.<ref name="BoSSotDS">''[[Book of Sith: Secrets from the Dark Side]]''</ref> The name of this technique referred to the [[veshet]], a species of large rodents with a keen sense of smell.<ref name="Insecurities">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/livingforce/swlf20040513|text=Insecurities|int=Insecurities}}</ref>
